candidate: Rainbow Jackpots / Red Tiger Daily Drop

facts: JOKERBET.es states it operates under VERAMATIC ONLINE, S.A. with Spanish Government/DGOJ licences.
The MAZ/2017/042 licence covers slots/maquinas de azar.

exactSpainGame.title: Rainbow Jackpots
exactSpainGame.notes: The operator page contains a jackpot-related metadata field, but the public page does not expose the exact Daily/10-Minute/Super tier configuration or current timer/value. Do not promote this signal to exact overlay binding.

facts: Rainbow Jackpots includes Red Tiger progressive and timed jackpots.
The Daily Drop is a timed prize that must be won before its deadline.
Higher stake is described as increasing the probability of triggering the jackpot game.
The Rainbow Jackpots rules glossary explicitly contains 10 Minute Drop, Daily Drop, Super Drop, Hourly Drop and Must Drop In terms.

rtpSemantics.primaryRule: The Rainbow Jackpots with Jackpot rule sheet states that displayed RTP includes base-game RTP and jackpot contribution.
rtpSemantics.criticalConsequence: The JOKERBET 95.17% headline must not be treated as base RTP and then have jackpot EV added on top. Exact base-vs-jackpot decomposition is required before live EV.

externalRtpRangeDiscovery.possibleButUnverifiedInference: A 95.17% total is numerically compatible with a 91.17% base-like configuration plus 4 percentage points of jackpot return if the reported adjustment is integer-percentage-point selectable. This is NOT verified and must not be used for a real-money decision.

facts: Total jackpot contribution is documented as 3% in that configuration.
For the first EUR2 of a wager, 90% of the jackpot contribution is allocated to Daily/10-Minute and 10% to Super, with Daily-vs-10-Minute dynamically allocated.
Above the first EUR2, additional jackpot contribution goes 100% to Super in that configuration.
Daily becomes hot at 21:00 CET/CEST and is guaranteed before midnight; 10 Minute Drop is guaranteed every ten minutes.
